enable_sandbox.description: Enter the user namespace and create a new mount namespace where only /etc and /run are mounted from the host.

enable_seccomp.description: Enable seccomp(2) to limit syscalls. Typically used in conjunction with --enable-sandbox. EXPERIMENTAL.

disable_host_loopback.description: Prohibit connecting to 127.0.0.1:* on the host namespace.

macaddress.description: Specify MAC address of the TAP interface (only valid with --configure/-c).

target_type.description: Specify the target type ([netns|bess], default=netns). The bess mode is EXPERIMENTAL.

outbound_addr.description: Specify outbound ipv4 address slirp should bind to.

outbound_addr_interface.description: Specify outbound interface slirp should bind to (ipv4 traffic only).

outbound_addr6.description: Specify outbound ipv6 address slirp should bind to.

outbound_addr6_interface.description: Specify outbound interface slirp should bind to (ipv6 traffic only).
